name: Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim AS
summary: Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim A.S. manufactures and distributes solar photovoltaic panels, catering to solar power installations both domestically within Turkey and internationally. Established in 2020 and headquartered in Ankara, Turkey, the company operates as a subsidiary of Kalyon Teknoloji Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
